classification.difficultyReason: Read the horizontal and vertical differences along the supplied legs, apply the taught Pythagorean distance calculation and round to two decimal places.

content.prompt: Calculate the distance of these intervals to 2 d.p. You won’t be able to use a ruler.

spec.mathematics: Endpoints (1,10) and (7,3); horizontal difference 6 and vertical length 7. Axes show x=0 to 8 and y=0 to 10.
spec.answerVisibility: Both leg boxes are blank; the distance answer is hidden.

answer.worked:
Run: $7-1=6$. Rise: $3-10=-7$, so the vertical length is $7$.
$$\begin{align*}d&=\sqrt{(-7)^2+6^2}\\d&=\sqrt{85}\\d&\approx9.22\text{ units}\end{align*}$$
